entry.title: New: dsh-memento
entry.summary: Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory: a typed `ctx.memory` seam with a zero-dependency SQLite provider, a `memory` tool, and frozen snapshot injection; every write passes the approval gate and stays reconstructable from the session log. Exact install spec: github:perrylink/dsh-memento. Source event: beancookie/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
